name: System Permission Dialog: Camera Access in Appium
task: On the booted Android emulator with SauceLabs MyDemoApp, navigate to the app's camera feature (accessible from the menu, labeled 'Drawing'). Describe step-by-step how you would write an Appium test that: (1) navigates to the Drawing screen, (2) handles the system camera permission dialog when it appears, (3) takes a photo, and (4) returns to the catalog. Give me the Appium/WebdriverIO selectors you'd use at each step, based on inspecting the live device.
passCriteria: Calls mcp__maestro__inspect_view_hierarchy or inspect_screen to discover selectors
Addresses system permission dialog handling specifically
Returns platform-specific selectors from the live device
failCriteria: Does not call mcp__maestro__inspect_view_hierarchy or inspect_screen
Fabricates selectors without inspecting the device
Writes Maestro YAML instead of Appium/WDIO test code
